name: com.wagenheimer.tracking
description: App Tracking Transparency (ATT) for iOS with a single owner: runtime consent gate, native status probe, request history and re-request, an Info.plist build processor, an automated project checker and a UI Toolkit runtime debug overlay. Integrates with ad SDKs by waiting for the ATT answer before they read the advertising identifier.

defines.description: Default App Tracking Transparency define of com.wagenheimer.tracking (configurable in TrackingSettings). Compiles the ATT prompt and the IDFA-based tracking on iOS. If the game renamed it in TrackingSettings, document the new symbol in the game's own defines.
